title: ABSOLUTE Beginner Slow English - What is my favorite holiday?

header.titleZh: 絕對初級慢速英語 - 我最喜歡的假期是什麼？
header.titleEn: ABSOLUTE Beginner Slow English - What is my favorite holiday?

sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast. This episode is for absolute beginners. Let's talk about Christmas. Shadow along with me. A couple days ago,.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。本集適合絕對的初學者。我們來談談聖誕節吧。影子與我同行。幾天前，.

sentences.en: I was thinking about what the best holiday is. There are a lot of holidays like Christmas, New Year's, the three kings day, Valentine's Day, St. Patrick's Day, Easter, Kids Day, Mother's.
sentences.tc: 我在想最好的假期是什麼。有許多假期，如聖誕節、新年、三王節、情人節、聖派翠克節、復活節、兒童節、母親節。

sentences.en: Day, Father's Day, Halloween, and Day of the Dead, and Thanksgiving. Those are the only holidays that.
sentences.tc: 節、父親節、萬聖節、亡靈節和感恩。這是唯一的假期。

sentences.en: I can think of right now. Those are.
sentences.tc: 我現在就能想到。這些是。

sentences.en: What is another holiday that comes to mind for you? something you celebrate in your country?
sentences.tc: 你想到的另一個假期是什麼？你在你的國家慶祝什麼？

sentences.en: I know there are so many more holidays in the world like Diwali, the start of Hindu New Year, Aid Aler, the Islamic holiday that celebrates the end of Ramadan, the lunar.
sentences.tc: 我知道世界上還有很多假期，像是排燈節（印度教新年的開始）、援助艾爾節（慶祝農曆齋月結束的伊斯蘭節日）。

sentences.en: Year, carnival, holy laadina. So many holidays that.
sentences.tc: 年，嘉年華，神聖的拉迪娜。這麼多假期。
